profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Rhythm
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Experienced Staff Software Engineer with a passion for front-end technologies. Passionate about TypeScript, and agnostic about frameworks. Bachelor of Science (B.S.) in Computer Science from Rutgers University.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Currently creating tools for the engineering team aimed to unify the developing experience in our React front-end framework.
• After acquisition, integrated the Honest Buildings platform and the Procore platform, creating a unified experience for both Honest Buildings and Procore customers.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer / Tech Lead
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Primary Focus as a Tech Lead/Staff Engineer in Front End Architecture.

• Helped Honest Buildings grow from a 12-employee Start-Up to a successful 160+ employee Start-Up.
• Interviewed 130+ engineers, 30+ product managers, and 20+ people for other positions during a 5-year span.
• Tech lead on 3 different teams writing dozens of features.
• Introduced Angular 8 as the successor of AngularJs. Features included Ahead of Time compilation internationalization (i18n) build, accessibility (a11y), lazy loading, and a design system available in Storybook.
• Worked as a liaison between Product and Engineering.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Switched the team from JavaScript to TypeScript.
• Introduced component-based architecture, leading us to have more reusable code as well as our first version of a design system.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Switched front-end build from Gulp to Webpack as a prerequisite for the introduction of Typescript.
• Implemented CI system in CircleCi given its unique support for Docker at the time. Change made CI 5 times faster and reduced 40% the amount of money spent on continuous integration.

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Technology Analyst in the Market Risk Technology team.

- Develop software in a Goldman Sachs proprietary programming language.
- Build APIs for analysis of jobs at Goldman Sachs' Cloud Computing Platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Software Engineer Intern in the Product Life Management team. 

- Developed software that automates the calculation of Health Effect Rating (HER) Score of chemicals used in company’s products.
- Created dynamic PDF forms with detailed information of the company’s products. Forms are used within all Colgate-Palmolive’s plants across the world.

positions.title: Winlab Android Research
positions.description:
Studied how Android OS mobile apps could enhance people’s lives.
Developed an app that maximizes user’s time by calculating the most efficient ways a user can accomplish tasks while driving to a place. App developed using the Google Android SDK as well as the Google Maps API.

projects.title: Conference Central Web App
projects.description:
Final project for Udacity Developing Scalable Apps UD853 using Google App Engine and Google Cloud Enpoints in Java. Project involved creating a Conference Web App where people can create/edit/delete conferences and sessions for each conference, as well as managing Task Queues, Cron Jobs, and Memcache with Objectify.

Website: http://cafesanu-gae.appspot.com/
Code: https://github.com/cafesanu/udacity-developing_scalable_apps

projects.title: Build a Wiki Platform
projects.description:
Final project for Udacity Backend Web Development CS253 using Google App Engine/Python. Project was about creating a Wiki platform with sessions, salted SHA-256 passwords, version history of each wikipage using GAE Datastore, and using memcache for wikipages created recently.

Website: http://cafesanu-cs253-final-project.appspot.com/
Code: https://github.com/cafesanu/udacity-back_end_web_development_gae_python
